text:
Alex: Quick async — following up on RCA-457. We still have 4 trailing items that need clear owners and due dates: (1) update postmortem doc with mitigation steps, (2) canary runbook + playbook, (3) telemetry dashboard for SLO drift alerts, (4) runtime fix for KV-cache edge case. Who can pick which?

Marie: I can take the postmortem doc and make the mitigation steps actionable. Target EOD Thu?

Jordan: I can own the canary runbook, but need a quick dependency check with infra for the canary infra (gpu pool). @Samir can you confirm capacity/slots and any blackout windows?

Samir: Looking now — infra has a maintenance window Mon 00:00–03:00 UTC next week. I can reserve a small pool for a canary on Tue/Wed if that works. Will post capacity numbers later today.

Priya: I can do the telemetry dashboard (bake a panel + alert rules). Can we agree on the main signal: 95th latency + failed tokens metric? Also will need sample queries from eng-runtime.

Jordan: That signal sounds good. @Alex can you paste the current query or the metrics names?

Alex: Sure — runtime exposes metrics `redwood_runtime.request_duration_ms{p99}`, `redwood_runtime.failed_tokens_total`. Quick snippet:```promql
sum(rate(redwood_runtime.failed_tokens_total[5m])) by (route)
```

Alex: For the runtime fix (item 4) I think Samir and Jordan should pair — Samir for infra-facing behavior, Jordan for runtime patch. Can we target a patch and canary on Wed and full rollout next Monday?

Samir: OK to pair. I can spare a 2h pairing slot Wed 14:00 UTC.

Jordan: Wed 14:00 works. I'll prep a small PR and link it here beforehand. PR will include a unit test and a short reproducer.

Marie: For the doc: I'll create a PR to the ops/postmortems repo and tag the pm + legal for the redacted timeline. ETA Thu EOD as noted.

Priya: Dashboard ETA Friday lunchtime if I get the queries by EOD today.

Alex: Great. Summarizing owners + due dates: postmortem doc — Marie — Thu EOD; canary runbook — Jordan — PR by Tue, run Wed (pair with Samir) ; telemetry dashboard — Priya — Fri 12:00 UTC; runtime fix — Jordan+Samir — patch+canary Wed, rollout Mon. If anybody needs to swap, call it out now.

inc-bot: Reminder: add action items to INC-942 tracker and set due dates. Current tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-942

Samir: I've added a tentative canary reservation and linked to the tracker. Will update capacity numbers in the tracker by 16:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/814 — draft up, tests failing (working on it).

Marie: I'll watch the PR and drop doc link once I open it. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

Alex: Awesome — will check back end of day. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-oncall and add a note in INC-942.

Priya: ack

Jordan: ack

Marie: ack
